show.description: Sharaabi Fighter is a martial arts action-drama about hidden power, redemption, and destiny. Bablu, a ridiculed drunkard handyman at a legendary Kung Fu academy, secretly possesses the strength of the mythical “Iron Head.” As enemies challenge the academy and imposters claim his glory, Bablu must decide whether to keep hiding in the shadows—or rise as the true legend who can save them all.
